lessons.text: Search the AP mailbox via /mail?folder=inbox&q=<keyword> (e.g., vendor name or invoice number substring); if no invoice email is present, locate existing bills in ERP via GET /vendors?q=<vendor> then GET /bills?vendor_id=<id>.

On the ERP bill detail page, attempting to schedule payment for a bill with amount ≥ ₹50,000 can fail with 'approval declined (large-payment)' and leave payment_date null; after the click, verify via GET /bills/{bill_id} before assuming success.

ERP bill payment scheduling is initiated by setting the 'Payment date' date field on the bill detail page (/erp/bills/{bill_id}); Finance Manager approval is required for amounts ≥ ₹50,000 and may be declined in this environment.

To notify the AP lead, open /mail/compose, set To to priya.nair@kestrel.in, include vendor, invoice number, amount, bill ID, and payment date/status in subject/body, then click Send; no external approval needed for internal Kestrel addresses.
If an invoice already exists as a bill in ERP (duplicate), do not create a new bill; report the existing bill ID and status to the AP lead via email and avoid unintended duplicate records.
